items.Name: Garb
items.Description: A must for the agile warrior or silent assassin, this cloth garb was made with noteable precision

items.Name: Robe
items.Description: Flowing with arcane contours, this fine cloth robe is the dress of choice for those who dabble in the magic arts.

items.Name: Cover
items.Description: Nice and thick for winter battles. If your enemy's blood won't keep you warm, this will!

items.Name: Toughened Leather
items.Description: Chewed and sunbaked countless times, this comfortable leather suit is deceptively protective for something that feels so comfortable to wear.

items.Name: Studded Leather
items.Description: Often underestimated, this fancy version of the leather garb not only looks cool, but offers added protection.

items.Name: Banded
items.Description: A little tougher than leather, a little lighter than chain, banded mail is the ideal solution for the support combateer.

items.Name: Breastplate
items.Description: Designed to protect the heart without weighing down the adventurer, this breastplate comes with abdominal air conditioning!

items.Name: Chain
items.Description: This mail, while a little noisy is surprisingly light.

items.Name: Half-plate
items.Description: Often refered to as a 'poor man's plate', this heavy armor will do the job while you save your coppers for a suit of wonderful full-plate.

items.Name: Plate
items.Description:
The staple armor for tanks and frontline warriors, this full plate will stop (most) arrows and protect you from crushing blows. 

Note: be careful not to get your head cleaved off.

items.Name: Battleaxe
items.Description: Slightly smaller and lighter than its twin the greataxe, this sturdy balanced weapon has the capability to cleave entire bodies in half. The largest pools of blood on the battlefield are usually the result of a rather nasty battleaxe wound.

items.Name: Belt 1
items.Description: Sometimes used to denote rank or status of martial standing, belts are one's primary means of holding up one's pants!

items.Name: Belt 2
items.Description: Sometimes used to denote rank or status of martial standing, belts are one's primary means of holding up one's pants!

items.Name: Boots 1
items.Description: These boots were made for fightin' and that just what they'll do. Hopefully these boots won't someday stomp all over you!

items.Name: Boots 2
items.Description: These boots were made for fightin' and that just what they'll do. Hopefully these boots won't someday stomp all over you!

items.Name: Boots 3
items.Description: These boots were made for fightin' and that just what they'll do. Hopefully these boots won't someday stomp all over you!

items.Name: Bracers 1
items.Description: These items at first appear to be simple wrist or arm guards, but closer inspection will reveal that they hold properties that deem the wearer more powerful than they appear.

items.Name: Bracers 2

items.Name: Bracers 3

items.Name: Cloak 1
items.Description: Looking very suave indeed, these garments don't hang stylishly off their wearer solely to impress. They also often hold untold magical powers.

items.Name: Cloak 2

items.Name: Club
items.Description: A prehistoric mating tool that somehow found it's way to the battlefield. Clubs can deliver a nasty blow to the head but are practically useless against the bodys of well armed opponents. Spikes were added to the head of the club to increase its effectiveness, but nontheless, th…

items.Name: Dagger
items.Description: Often underestimated, the dagger is a lethal weapon in the hands of a skilled fighter. Popular among assassins and rogues for its propensity to kill quickly and silently, the dagger is definitely the weapon of choice for the silent killer.

items.Name: Two-Bladed Sword
items.Description: A popular orc weapon, the double-bladed sword is more intimidating than it is effective.

items.Name: Double Axe
items.Description: These versatile weapons, while very impractical on the battlefield, make for great boat anchors or main-poles for the pitching of tents in overnight camps. Very few can wield these ridiculous weapons effectively, though those who can are greatly respected and feared.

items.Name: Dire Mace
items.Description: Bulky and feasome, this huge weapon is often wielded by equally hulking figures. Slow and cumbersome yet absolutely devestating, the dire mace is not a weapon you want to be critted by.

items.Name: Greataxe
items.Description: This formidible axe is the favoured weapon of barbarians and strength fighters. Its carefully balanced bladed head is conducive to a myriad of martial maneuvers allowing fighters to marry its deadly power with formidible precision. Sustaining a critical hit on the wrong end of t…

items.Name: Halberd
items.Description: Ideal for counter maneuvers against ensuing steeded knights, this long deadly weapon is a favourite defense weapon for siege warfare.

items.Name: Handaxe
items.Description: Usually wielded in pairs, this fast speeded weapon is an invaluable tool in the arsenol of assassins, rogues and duel wielding combatants.

items.Name: Heavy Crossbow
items.Description: Nothing short of a launcher of certain death, these hulking ranged weapons have the power to knock a foe off its feet, passing through the body with enough power left to both claim a second kill and maim a third.

items.Name: Helm 1
items.Description: While often hot and stuffy with inadequate air conditioning, these hardy helms can save the life of the wearer time and time again, making them annoyingly essential to wear. They also look rather cool.

items.Name: Helm 2
items.Description: While often hot and stuffy with inadequate air conditioning, these hardy helms can save the life of the wearer time and time again, making them annoyingly essential to wear. They also look rather cool.

items.Name: Helm 3
items.Description: While often hot and stuffy with inadequate air conditioning, these hardy helms can save the life of the wearer time and time again, making them annoyingly essential to wear. They also look rather cool.

items.Name: Heavy Flail
items.Description: A favourite weapon of divine strength warriors and large clerics, the heavy flail makes up for the sacraficing of shields with its power-assisted pivoting capabilities. A well aimed hit with these weapons can shatter a chestplate or splinter a shield with no trouble at all.

items.Name: Kama
items.Description: This hook-like exotic bladed weapon is practically standard equipment for the likes of monks and the elusive shinobi warriors. Capable of weaving a complex array of offensive and defensive moves simultaneously, the kama strikes fear into the hearts of those unfortunate enough to…

items.Name: Katana
items.Description: It is a mystery as to where these deadly blades came from, though an irefutable certainty that they of a quality befitting only those who possess skills worthy of wielding such a weapon.

items.Name: Kukri
